field.description: Every archetype template expanded at the round, seeds x 6 archetypes, budget 1000 permille

median_attacker.description: The generalist template at median budget; results averaged over seeds

strongest_defence.description: A hill-climb over legal, constructible, gimmick-free builds at the round, maximising the tick at which Loyalty first reaches 0 against median_attacker; 200 iterations from the fortress template at 1200 permille

mirror.description: A template against itself, different seeds

agent_run.description: A greedy builder plays 16 rounds against field rivals, buying the highest harness-scored option each round; 100 runs

optimizer.description: A hill-climb over constructible builds maximising win rate against field at the round; 200 iterations; used for outlier detection and pick rates

counters.why: The earner has the Revenue and none of the Loyalty to keep it
Loyalty and regen soak Poaches that arrive in bursts
Loyalty does not stop Sales; the fortress makes too little
Scandal erodes the cap the fortress paid for
Retriggers and HR cleanse out-tempo a slow Burnout stack
Sales that never stop outgrow a retrigger core
The generalist is the median, not a counter; it sits inside the band against everyone

invariants.name: No defence survives to the Bell
invariants.statement: Against median_attacker, the strongest_defence build's Loyalty reaches 0 before the Bell in every seed.
invariants.measure: max over seeds of first tick at which defender loyalty == 0

invariants.name: Fights do not open flat
invariants.statement: In field matches Revenue first moves early.
invariants.measure: median and P90 over matches of the first tick with revenueDelta != 0

invariants.name: No archetype dominates the field
invariants.statement: Each archetype's win rate against the field, mirror excluded, lies inside the band.

invariants.name: Counters exist and are not walls
invariants.statement: Each listed counter pair's win rate lies inside the counter band.
invariants.measure: win rate permille of winner vs loser

invariants.name: Mirrors are fair
invariants.statement: A template against itself with different seeds is close to even.
invariants.measure: win rate permille of side A

invariants.name: Crunch is the swing
invariants.statement: Every quarter runs to the Bell (D-85). In field matches a firm behind or level after Crunch begins still wins sometimes, but not so often that a lead means nothing; draws are rare.
invariants.measure: permille of decided matches whose winner was not strictly ahead at some tick from the start of Crunch; draw rate

invariants.name: Chip cannot hold regen down alone
invariants.statement: No shop-available employee whose base Poach value reaches the round's suppression threshold has a cooldown under 60 ticks.
invariants.measure: for each (employee, round): basePoach >= suppressThreshold(round) implies cooldownTicks >= 60

invariants.name: No one hit claims the quarter
invariants.statement: No single resolution in a field match moves more than 15% of the quarter's combined Revenue.
invariants.measure: max over entries of |revenueDelta| as permille of finalRevenue A + B

invariants.name: The portal is a gamble, not an upgrade
invariants.statement: Each shop extraplanar employee with each rider, substituted into field towers for its cost-matched tier equivalent, does not raise win rate above the cap.
invariants.measure: win rate permille of the substituted tower

invariants.name: Rooms are commitments
invariants.statement: A greedy agent playing full runs rarely demolishes.
invariants.measure: median rooms demolished per run, permille

invariants.name: Relocation is a valve, not a habit
invariants.statement: A greedy agent playing full runs relocates rooms rarely; if it relocates freely, the fee or the Tenure penalty is too soft.
invariants.measure: median rooms relocated per run, permille

invariants.name: Holding is not a strategy
invariants.statement: A builder that stops buying after round 8 and relies on Tenure alone loses to the field in the late rounds; if it does not, Tenure outpays active spending.
invariants.population: agent_run variant: no purchases after round 8
invariants.measure: win rate permille vs field over rounds 12-16

invariants.name: Floors stay a decision
invariants.statement: From round 8, at least half of field towers carry a floor-selected status ability.
invariants.measure: fraction permille of towers with >=1 enemy-targeted status effect

invariants.name: The live ledger stays readable
invariants.statement: After coalescing, the live ledger's line rate stays under budget.
invariants.measure: P95 over 1-second windows of coalesced lines per firm

invariants.name: Wins are not one card
invariants.statement: In field wins, no single ability supplies most of the winner's Revenue.
invariants.measure: P50 over matches of max share permille of the winner's Revenue gained from one abilityId
invariants.source: PLANNING_PROMPT quality bar: combination over quantity

invariants.name: Bosses teach what they are meant to
invariants.statement: Each boss loses to its favoured archetype at least as often as listed and beats its punished archetype at least as often as listed.
invariants.measure: win rate permille of the archetype vs the boss

invariants.name: Rivals are affordable
invariants.statement: Every template at every round expands to a constructible snapshot for every seed.

invariants.name: Nothing is never picked
invariants.statement: Content the optimizer picks less than the floor rate is flagged for review.

invariants.name: The sim stays fast
invariants.statement: A single simulate() call stays under budget at round 16.
